definition: Annuitant is an investor or a pension plan beneficiary who is entitled to receive the regular payments of a pension or an annuity. Cases such as Estate of Frederick v. Frederick (1996), explain that an ‘annuitant’ “enjoys status similar to that of creditor, while ‘beneficiary of an annuity’ retains nothing more than animal testing / annuitant Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026 expectancy interest until annuitant or policy holder passes away.”
